title: The Dicing and the Sequal to Dicing

vibeProfile.oneLine: The Mahabharata's fateful dice game and its sequel.

summary: The famous dice-game episode from the Mahabharata and its immediate sequel, in which the eldest Pandava, Yudhishthira, is lured into a rigged game and gambles away everything, including his brothers and their wife Draupadi, whose public humiliation sets the great epic's war in motion. Presented as a study text with translation, it isolates one of the most charged and consequential passages in all of Indian literature, a turning point of honour, fate and revenge.
whyReadIt: The Mahabharata's pivotal dice game, where a kingdom and a queen are gambled away. One of the epic's most charged passages.

funFacts.text: Draupadi's question during the dice game, whether a man who has lost himself can then stake his wife, is one of the epic's great moral cruxes.
